page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.1-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine engineered for standard computing tasks. It runs on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8358 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The configuration allocates 2 virtual CPUs mapped to a single physical core via two threads per core, providing dedicated CPU allocation without shared-core throttling. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding a symmetrical 4.0 GB of RAM per allocated compute core, which aligns with typical general-purpose resource allocations.

Hardware acceleration is absent on this shape, as it includes zero GPUs. Local storage is designated as None, requiring instances to attach remote block storage volumes for both root filesystem deployment and transactional persistence. Network connectivity is augmented by one complimentary public IPv4 address, facilitating direct ingress and egress routing for public-facing utilities. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute cycles, avoiding noisy-neighbor interference common in burstable virtual platforms.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the VM.Standard3.Flex.1-8 offers a balanced memory-to-core configuration suited for light to medium production duties. Because the resource profile balances compute and memory evenly without high-density accelerators or integrated NVMe storage, it serves well for running containerized microservices, entry-level web serving tiers, continuous integration build agents, and staging environments.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.1-8 is a general-purpose compute instance configured with 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of memory. Driven by a dedicated 2.6 GHz Intel Xeon 8358 processor on the x86_64 architecture, the configuration spans one physical core and two hardware threads. The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio provides a balanced hardware profile suitable for moderate utility workloads. This instance contains no onboard local storage, necessitating external network-attached block volumes for system operating systems and persistent data retention. It also operates without hardware-accelerated GPU resources. Included with the instance is a single complimentary public IPv4 address for external network routing. Given its modest dedicated compute capacity and balanced memory footprint, VM.Standard3.Flex.1-8 functions effectively as an entry-level platform for web servers, lightweight microservices, development environments, and small-scale background job processing.
